capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned base block 52131494 (hash 0x3d31cbc91a3065f9b4817af44865cd30cc82c4e13d49a1e322571745d55e15e5). The pinned exact immutable MetaMorphoV1_1 source inherits ERC4626 deposit/mint: _deposit transfers USDC before _mint. Owner/curator submitCap changes market allocation limits and setFee changes a source-capped fraction of earned interest; accrued fee shares are formula-derived, not an arbitrary privileged recipient mint. Configuration and delegated owner execution cannot replace this immutable vault code or bypass the asset-funded user issuance path. Inherited controls concern usdc-circle, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14.
